Chat with it and ask for songs, your playlists (including Favorites and the smart ones), or to pause and skip; it calls you by name and talks like a person. It understands your voice with Whisper (using the same Groq API key as above, nothing else to set up) and, if there\'s no internet or the quota runs out, it uses Android\'s speech recognition.
While it is off, neither the power button nor the tile does anything.
Uses the system voice (no extra size).
Whisper ready: your Groq API key will be used.
No Groq API key: Android\'s speech recognition will be used.

Android doesn\'t let an app capture the power button by itself. What it does allow is choosing MusicFlame as your digital assistant: then, holding the power button opens it. How long you must hold is decided by Android (on some phones it\'s adjustable in system Settings > Power button); the app can\'t set it to 2 or 4 seconds.
MusicFlame isn\'t your digital assistant yet
